get.description:
Server-Sent Events over committed RunEvent rows.

Frames use `id:` = run-local sequence, `event:` = one of
(run.started, step.started, measurement.recorded, step.completed, run.completed, run.cancelled, run.interrupted, run.errored) and `data:` = the
RunEventEnvelopeDto JSON envelope.

Replay sends only events newer than the cursor in strict sequence order and
then follows the same table. A `: heartbeat` comment is sent every 15 seconds
and consumes no domain sequence. A terminal event is always the last frame,
after which the server closes the connection.

info.title: ProbeDesk API
info.description: Versioned measurement plans, deterministic simulated runs and run comparison. All routes are served under /api.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Session login, logout, current user and CSRF protection.

session.name: probedesk_session
session.description: HttpOnly session cookie. The raw value is never returned in a response body.

csrfToken.name: X-XSRF-TOKEN
csrfToken.description: Session-bound double-submit token. Echo the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie value on every authenticated mutation.

path.description: Dotted field path, array indexes included.

message.example: maximum must be greater than or equal to minimum

code.description: Stable application error code. This list matches the API contract.

requestId.description: Correlation id also returned in the X-Request-Id header.

details.description: Safe, non-sensitive context for the error.

failureStepId.description: Required for FORCED_FAILURE only: the logicalStepId of the failing step in this published version.

errorProbability.description: Required for RANDOM only: decimal failure probability between 0 and 1 with at most 6 fractional digits.

deviceId.description: Optional active device of the same profile. Its name and serial number are copied into the run snapshot.

batchNumber.description: Optional batch number. It is trimmed; empty input is absent. The displayed value keeps its case and filters use its uppercase canonical key.

status.description: RUNNING for a newly created run. A replay returns the stored current status, which may already be terminal.

outcome.description: Overall outcome. Null until a COMPLETED run has a verdict; a terminal replay reports the stored value.

stepPosition.description: 1-based position of the failing step inside the run.

sampleIndex.description: Zero-based index of the first out-of-tolerance sample.

deviceId.description: Device linked at start, or null for legacy and device-less runs.

deviceSnapshot.description: Device values copied at start, or null. Later device edits never change history.

batchNumber.description: Batch display value copied at start, or null.

outcome.description: Overall verdict; only a COMPLETED run has one.

outOfToleranceCount.description: Sum of the stored step out-of-tolerance counters. Aggregate only; use the run snapshot for per-step values.

firstFailure.description: Earliest failure by step position and sample index, or null when no recorded sample is out of tolerance.

partial.description: True only when fewer samples were recorded than expected. A terminal CANCELLED, INTERRUPTED or ERROR run that recorded every expected sample is not partial; status and outcome communicate the stop.

total.description: Total number of runs matching the filters.

totalPages.description: Number of pages for this filter and limit. Zero when no run matches.

description.example: Deterministic simulated DC power module used for local demonstrations.

minimum.description: Smallest recorded sample, or null for a partial step.

maximum.description: Largest recorded sample, or null for a partial step.

average.description: Rounded average, or null for a partial step.

sampleCount.description: Sample count covered by the stored summary, or null when no summary exists.

outcome.description: Step verdict. Null unless the step is COMPLETED; a partial step can still report an out-of-tolerance sample.

firstFailureSampleIndex.description: Index of the first out-of-tolerance sample, if any.

hasOutOfTolerance.description: True exactly when outOfToleranceCount is greater than zero. Available even while outcome is null.

measurements.description: Recorded samples ordered by ascending sampleIndex.

deviceId.description: Device linked at start, or null for legacy and device-less runs.

deviceSnapshot.description: Device values copied at start, or null when the run had no device. Later device edits do not change it.

batchNumber.description: Batch display value copied at start, or null. The canonical filter key is internal.

errorProbability.description: Canonical probability for RANDOM, otherwise null.

failureStepId.description: Logical step selected for FORCED_FAILURE, otherwise null.

outcome.description: Overall verdict; only a COMPLETED run has one.

reasonCode.description: Safe technical reason code for an ERROR or cancellation.

lastEventSequence.description: Sequence of the last committed run event covered by this snapshot. Use it as the initial SSE cursor.

sequence.description: Run-local event sequence. It is also the SSE id field and increases without gaps.

occurredAt.description: Commit timestamp copied from the persisted RunEvent row.

payload.description: Event-specific payload. It never contains session, password, draft or idempotency data.

description.description: Trimmed description, or null when it is empty.

archivedAt.description: Archive time, or null while the device is active.

editRevision.description: Optimistic concurrency revision. Updates, archive and restore require the current value.

totalPages.description: Number of pages for this filter and limit, zero when empty.

description.description: Optional description. It is trimmed; empty or whitespace-only input is stored as null.

expectedRevision.description: Current editRevision. A mismatch is rejected with DEVICE_CONFLICT and no writes.

description.description: New description. It is trimmed; null, empty or whitespace-only input clears it.

expectedRevision.description: Current editRevision. A stale value is always rejected with DEVICE_CONFLICT.

logicalStepId.description: Permanent logical identity shared by every revision of this plan.

baseVersionId.description: Published revision this draft was copied from, if any.

name.description: Draft name for a Planner when a draft exists; latest published name otherwise.

draft.description: Open draft with steps. Present only in a Planner response.

published.description: Latest published revision with steps, if one exists.

name.description: Draft name for a Planner; latest published name for Operator and Viewer.

latestPublishedVersion.description: Highest published version summary, or null before publish.

draft.description: Present only in a Planner response. Operator and Viewer responses omit the key.

logicalStepId.description: Existing logical step identity. Omit, send null or send an empty string for a new step; the server creates and returns a new identity.

expectedRevision.description: Current editRevision from the draft. A mismatch is rejected with DRAFT_CONFLICT and no writes.
Current editRevision of the open draft. A mismatch is rejected with DRAFT_CONFLICT and nothing is published.

planId.description: New independent plan created by the copy.

draftRevisionId.description: Initial draft revision created with the copy. The id stays stable after the draft is saved or published.

sourceVersionId.description: Published source revision named in the request path.

replayed.description: True when an earlier request for the same user, Idempotency-Key and canonical request is replayed.

outcome.description: Stored step verdict. Null unless the step completed; partial steps keep their recorded samples.

hasOutOfTolerance.description: True exactly when outOfToleranceCount is greater than zero.

statistics.description: Stored summary for a completed step; every numeric member is null for a partial step.

measurements.description: Only the samples actually recorded, ordered by ascending sampleIndex. Missing samples are never invented.

generatedAt.description: UTC time at which this projection was generated.

deviceId.description: Device linked at start, or null for legacy and device-less runs.

deviceSnapshot.description: Device values copied at start. Later device edits never change it.

batchNumber.description: Batch display value copied at start, or null when the run had no batch.

errorProbability.description: Canonical six-place probability for RANDOM, otherwise null.

failureStepId.description: Logical step selected for FORCED_FAILURE, otherwise null.

outcome.description: Overall verdict; only a COMPLETED run has one.

reasonCode.description: Safe technical reason code for a terminal non-success.

requestedBy.description: Public requester summary. Session and password fields are never included.

from.description: Canonical UTC inclusive lower bound actually applied.

to.description: Canonical UTC exclusive upper bound actually applied.

planVersionId.description: Applied published version filter, or null.

batchNumber.description: Applied canonical uppercase batch key, or null. Filtering is exact and case-insensitive on the stored key.

passRatePercent.description: 100 × passedRuns / completedRuns, rounded half-up to two decimal places by PostgreSQL numeric. Null when completedRuns is zero.

averageDurationMs.description: Mean finishedAt-startedAt duration of COMPLETED runs with a finish time, rounded half-up to three decimal places. Null when no sample exists.

passRatePercent.description: Day pass rate as a two-decimal half-up string, or null when the day has no COMPLETED run.

completedStepRuns.description: COMPLETED steps in COMPLETED runs for this plan/version/logical step/unit group.

failedStepRuns.description: COMPLETED steps whose recorded outcome is FAILED.

failureRatePercent.description: 100 × failedStepRuns / completedStepRuns, rounded half-up to two decimal places. Null only when the denominator is zero.

asOf.description: Transaction snapshot timestamp. Summary, trend and top steps all come from the same repeatable-read snapshot.

trend.description: Every UTC day intersecting the range, including zero-count days.

topFailedSteps.description: At most ten failing step groups ordered by failedStepRuns DESC, completedStepRuns DESC and permanent ids.

sameVersion.description: True when both runs executed the same plan version.

deviceId.description: Device linked at start, or null for legacy and device-less runs.

deviceSnapshot.description: Device values copied into this run at start, or null. The live device is never joined.

batchNumber.description: Batch display value copied at start, or null.

errorProbability.description: Canonical probability for RANDOM, otherwise null.

failureStepId.description: Logical step selected for FORCED_FAILURE, otherwise null.

outcome.description: Overall verdict; null for CANCELLED, INTERRUPTED and ERROR runs.

reasonCode.description: Safe technical/cancellation reason code, if any.

stepCount.description: Number of copied steps in this run.

partial.description: True when the run is not COMPLETED or recorded fewer samples than expected.

left.description: Left run value: decimal text for limits, integer otherwise.

right.description: Right run value: decimal text for limits, integer otherwise.

left.description: Left run value, or null when that run has no summary.

right.description: Right run value, or null when that run has no summary.

delta.description: right - left as a canonical six-place decimal. Null when either side is missing; never zero-filled.

left.description: Left run value, or null when that run has no summary.

delta.description: right - left, or null when either side is missing.

comparable.description: True exactly when both steps use the same unit.

statistics.description: Side-by-side summaries for the same unit, or null when units differ. Deltas are right - left.

changedFields.description: Changed rule fields in fixed order: name, unit, position, minimum, maximum, sampleCount, intervalMs. Empty when the rules are identical.

left.description: Left run step with its own copied limits, verdict and measurement series. The series is never aligned to the right one.

right.description: Right run step with its own copied limits, verdict and measurement series. The series is never aligned to the left one.

planId.description: The shared plan id. Both runs always belong to this plan.

matchedSteps.description: Steps present in both runs, ordered by left position then logicalStepId.

addedSteps.description: Steps that exist only in the right run, ordered by right position then logicalStepId. The left side is absent, not zero-filled.

removedSteps.description: Steps that exist only in the left run, ordered by left position then logicalStepId. The right side is absent, not zero-filled.
